args.description: Save each line of the list as a note
Find the notes with a mistaken tag

args.content:
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { byTag } from '@api/notes'

const texts = (await byTag('shop')).map(note => note.text)
writeFileSync('/tau/out/report.txt', texts.join('\n') + '\n')
console.log(JSON.stringify(texts))
